positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
·	Experience with MX (Money Desktop) vendor and integrating their aggregation application.
·	Familiarity with MX’s Zendesk application used for issue resolution 
·	Facilitate daily standups with Development team along with coordinating Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, and Retrospectives.  
·	Assist RTE with Release Train Increment planning and travel logistics.
·	Support Release Train Engineer with budget verification and Train headcount.
·	Provide feedback and input on Project tools for enhancement.

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description:
·	Review and manage Executive calendar activates to ensure accurate and efficient coordination of time and resources, including scheduling appointments, internal/external meetings and conference calls. 
·	Manage Executive Communications, including developing presentations and other documents on behalf of the CEO for speaking engagements and community relations. 
·	Discern issues/information to ensure that the Executive is apprised immediately of urgent information, especially those items that are sensitive, or raise some legal or public relations risk for the organization.
·	Plans, coordinates and secures logistics for all Executive meetings, travel and activities, including daily preparations with meeting agendas, attendee bios, travel logistics, and expense reports. 
·	Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures

positions.title: Product Manager I
positions.description:
-Developed and managed project plans while providing status updates to management.
-Created and upgraded new products using Agile methodologies by conducting sprint planning, backlog grooming, scrum master duties, creating personas, end of sprint demos, and retrospectives. 
-Worked with a group of Engineers to ensure product efficiency and demo products to Customers. 
-Led Customer demos and obtained customer feedback 
-Assisted in gathering product requirements and ensure product compatibility for Trade Show Preparations.

positions.title: Product Specialist II
positions.description:
-Prepared and presented product demos to Customers and leadership. 
-Assisted with regression testing for server based product.
-Created wire frames and personas for new products.
-Worked with Product team to improve product compatibility.

positions.title: Sourcing Manager I
positions.description:
-Negotiated with suppliers regarding product, service levels, payment terms and prices.
-Oversaw bidding processes.
-Determined recurring business needs and maintained necessary inventory levels.
-Conducted market research to determine appropriate pricing.
-Built competitive bidding environment with broad range of suppliers.

positions.title: Product Operations Engineer II
positions.description:
-Administrated and maintained Enterprise Order Management and Provisioning System.
-Supported a demanding 250+ global user base.
-Detailed business requirement into actionable system changes.
-Conducted training for users and administrators across all geographies.
-Supported numerous product launches in term of system readiness.
-Designed and implemented a Change Management policy to ensure availability and consistency for internal customers

positions.title: Purchasing Specialist I
positions.description:
-Organized purchasing backlog and deliver the request to the appropriate buyers.
-Worked closely with Accounts Payable for invoice and Purchase Order discrepancies.
-Oversaw and manage the products needed to build out the Hong Kong Datacenter.
-Build Vendor relationships to ensure competitive pricing and timely delivery of products.
-Negotiated and implemented cost effective outcome measures for marketing requests
